summary: End-to-end workflow: requirements, plan, tests, implementation, review and release.
intents: take this feature from spec all the way to a merged release
plan, build, test and ship a new feature end to end
run the full delivery workflow for this user story
go from requirements to a reviewed pull request for this feature
deliver this feature with tests, review and changelog
prerequisites: a feature request, user story or issue
repository access and a runnable test command

steps.goal: Turn the request into testable acceptance criteria and explicit non-goals
Choose an approach, list affected modules, risks and a rollback path
Write failing tests that encode each acceptance criterion
Implement the smallest change that makes the tests pass
Review the diff for defects, missing tests and credentials
Write the changelog entry and rollout and rollback notes

done_when: Every acceptance criterion maps to at least one passing test
The diff was reviewed and has no unresolved high-severity findings
A changelog entry and rollback note exist
